intro_summary: 本章先用黑底紅方塊把像素、圖塊與位置變成有軸的數字，接著與文字序列連接；短程式各自核對形狀、順序、梯度與輸入目標對齊，介面接通和學會看圖分別需要不同證據。最後改為圖文配對，區分從候選卡片選取與生成句子。

support_boundary: This review supports image encoding and short-program behavior. It does not assert real-photo linear luminance, a universal layout for all image libraries, mandatory /255 preprocessing for every model, or trained image understanding. Current source explicitly allows HWC loaders and requires the model convention to match.
